citation.title: Altered cholesterol homeostasis in critical illness-induced muscle weakness: effect of exogenous 3-hydroxybutyrate

decision: Retain mechanistic plausibility supported by an observational human association, intervention-associated sterol readouts in a reused mouse force cohort, and direct 13C incorporation into mevalonate in a separate tracer cohort. Necessity/sufficiency/mediation of force rescue by cholesterol is unresolved. No human ketone efficacy, dietary cholesterol efficacy, retail transfer or BUB1B/MVA mechanism.

citation.title: Altered cholesterol homeostasis in critical illness-induced muscle weakness: effect of exogenous 3-hydroxybutyrate

human.conclusion: Retain an adjusted observational association of lower early serum total cholesterol with later MRC-defined weakness in selected EPaNIC patients. Human ketone/supplement efficacy, cholesterol causality or mediation is not established; reported OR scaling and a sepsis covariate reversal remain unresolved.

mouse.model: 24-week-old male C57BL/6J CLP sepsis mice, centrally catheterized, fluids first 20 hours, antibiotics/analgesia and mixed PN Olimel N7E 5.8 kcal/day.

first_study.preparation: D,L-3HB sodium salt, 150 mg/day total, twice-daily subcutaneous injection; this paper does not restate catalogue, analytical isomer ratio, solvent, batch or purity. Earlier linked 2019 preparation details are separate context, not independent chemical verification here.
first_study.comparator: D-glucose, described as isocaloric/isovolumetric; no sodium-matched comparator. Healthy controls pair-fed.
first_study.reuse: Figures 1d and 4f explicitly say absolute EDL force previously quantified in reference 5, DOI 10.1186/s13054-019-2506-6. No new force replication or force-treatment estimate is credited.
first_study.survival: 17/20 versus 17/21, Wilcoxon P=.8 in native S1; no equality/safety proof. Main calls 17/21 82%, although arithmetic is 80.95%; counts retained as authoritative rather than rounded label.
first_study.missingness: Reasons for assay losses and pairwise complete n absent. Ubiquinone is missing 2/2/3 relative to reported surviving group labels. Do not substitute earlier specific-force n=15/16/14 for this paper’s absolute-force correlation pairs.
first_study.randomization_blinding: This paper does not specify animal sequence generation/allocation concealment or assay blinding. Prior animal paper details are not silently treated as new verification.
first_study.exclusions: Catheter-related problems mentioned; counts and per-endpoint flow absent.

outcomes.measurement: Total and free cholesterol measured with and without esterase; esterified fraction calculated as total minus free.
outcomes.result: Total and esterified higher, P≤.05; free higher, P≤.01; native markers.
outcomes.healthy_limit: Free cholesterol is also higher than healthy (P≤.05 native marker); do not claim all fractions normalized. Total/esterified healthy nonsignificance is not equivalence.
outcomes.precision: Median/IQR plots; no tabulated treatment differences/CIs.

outcomes.endpoint: Plasma esterified cholesterol versus reused absolute force
outcomes.analysis_limit: Pooled unadjusted correlation, group membership not distinguished/adjusted; no within-arm causal mediation.

outcomes.result: Higher, P≤.05 native marker; author-described normalization, not equivalence or direct flux measure.
Srebf2 higher P≤.01, Hmgcs1/Hmgcr higher P≤.001, Ldlr higher P≤.05. No drug-group difference marked for Fdft1, Aacs, Lpl, Abca1, Abcg1.
outcomes.limit: RNA normalized to Hprt/Rn18s; no protein activity or gene-specific causal perturbation.

outcomes.result: No salt-versus-placebo markers in hepatic panels; illness effects present.
outcomes.reporting_issue: Main says Hmgcs1 unaffected and Hmgcr upregulated only in salt-treated mice; native Hmgcs1 carries the healthy-comparison marker while Hmgcr has none. Preserve native/prose distinction.

outcomes.endpoint: Plasma ubiquinone-9 and tibialis citrate synthase/complex I
outcomes.result: Plasma ubiquinone-9 increased with sepsis without drug-group difference; citrate synthase/complex I activities remained lower than healthy without salt restoration.
outcomes.limit: Plasma ubiquinone and two homogenate enzyme activities do not exclude every mitochondrial mechanism; no intramuscular ubiquinone measurement or broad respiration assay demonstrated.

outcomes.endpoint: EDL total cholesterol and muscle Nceh1/Acat1 transcripts
outcomes.result: Salt increased whole-muscle total cholesterol P≤.05 and Nceh1 RNA P≤.05 versus glucose; no difference for reported Acat1.
outcomes.measurement: EDL homogenate lipids extracted; total cholesterol in duplicate, normalized to mg protein. Not isolated membranes or membrane free-cholesterol measurement.
outcomes.annotation_limit: Reported Acat1 assay identity is not Soat1; detailed identity check below.

outcomes.endpoint: Muscle total cholesterol versus reused absolute force
outcomes.limit: Pooled unadjusted associations; no formal mediation/necessity test.

first_study.harms_scope: This mechanism paper supplies survival comparison, not systematic new electrolyte/toxic-threshold or long-term safety assessment. Salt safety data from separately qualified studies must remain available; do not infer safety from these mechanistic endpoints.

second_tracer_study.preparation: Single 75 mg subcutaneous D,L-3HB-13C4 sodium salt (Sigma 606030) on day 2 or day 5; healthy controls receive equal bolus. Injection solvent/volume, isotopic purity and analytical isomer ratio not stated.
second_tracer_study.cohort_design: Separate cross-sectional groups sampled 2 hours after bolus; day 2/day 5 are not repeated measures in the same mice. Healthy controls full-fed; septic groups PN-fed. Feeding/illness state differences cannot be separated.
second_tracer_study.assays: LC-MS on plasma, liver and gastrocnemius extracts: labeled 3HB, mevalonate, citrate, fumarate. Each metabolite labeled fraction normalized to plasma 3HB fractional labeling per mouse.
second_tracer_study.native_findings: Figure 3b tissue 3HB normalized fractions are higher in muscle and lower in liver relative to plasma=1. Figure 3d muscle mevalonate labeling higher than healthy on day 2 (P≤.05) and day 5 (P≤.01), with author-reported sixfold and 16-fold increases. Plasma/liver mevalonate significant only day 5. Citrate/fumarate labeling also increases in selected muscle/liver comparisons.
second_tracer_study.strong_support: Carbon from administered ketone reaches mevalonate; labeling pattern differs during sepsis, supporting access to the mevalonate pathway.
not_established: No isotope measurement of final cholesterol, membrane cholesterol or ubiquinone
Single-time fractional enrichments are not uptake rates or absolute synthesis/oxidative fluxes
Comparisons of different metabolite fractional enrichments cannot alone rank absolute pathway throughput or rule out ATP substrate use
No sterol-pathway inhibition, knockout, cholesterol-specific rescue, or mediation analysis
No muscle-force endpoint in tracer cohort
No detailed statistical definition of overall fractional contribution pooling/aggregation across tissues in Figure 3c; repeated tissue observations not independently counted as animals
second_tracer_study.reporting_issue: Methods and native figure measure fumarate; a Discussion sentence instead says malate. Use actual assay/figure identity, no new malate endpoint inferred.

assay_identity_check.trigger: Main calls Acat1 a cholesterol-esterification enzyme; supplement Table S1 lists acetyl-CoA acetyltransferase 1, assay Mm00507463_m1.
assay_identity_check.manufacturer: Official Thermo assay page identifies mouse Acat1, Gene 110446, acetyl-Coenzyme A acetyltransferase 1; product gene function is mitochondrial acetoacetyl-CoA thiolase.
assay_identity_check.gene_record: NCBI Gene 110446 Acat1 is distinct from Gene 20652 Soat1, sterol O-acyltransferase 1 / acyl-coenzyme A:cholesterol acyltransferase 1.
assay_identity_check.interpretation: Unresolved reported-marker annotation/assay identity issue. Do not infer the actual reagent used beyond the reported assay or treat unchanged Acat1 as validated unchanged cholesterol esterification. This does not erase the separate cholesterol-content or tracer findings.
assay_identity_check.scope: One bounded primary manufacturer/NCBI identity check; no efficacy-source expansion.

statistics.mouse: Student t/ANOVA with Fisher LSD after transformations where needed; Wilcoxon/Median tests otherwise; two-sided P≤.05. Multiple nominal comparisons, no broader multiplicity correction described.
statistics.plots: Boxplots median/IQR; numerical treatment differences and confidence intervals not provided for mouse molecular outcomes. No digitization.
statistics.human: Two reported logistic models plus separate linear cholesterol model; exact scale/coding and diagnostic/missing-data details limited. Parent randomized nutrition does not randomize cholesterol/statins.
statistics.prospective_status: No prospective registered mechanism hierarchy/SAP verified; planned parent strength substudy does not establish prespecification of later cholesterol analysis.

correspondence_followup.reading: Complete publisher letter and embedded authors response, including disclosures. Referenced external papers not newly read.
correspondence_followup.critique: Questions the cholesterol/strength timing, endogenous ketones and pharmacokinetics, fatty-acid synthesis and indirect hepatic metabolism.
correspondence_followup.response: Authors selected an early blood timepoint because sampling stopped at ICU discharge, to avoid restricting later samples to long-stayers. They cite earlier nutrition-dependent ketogenesis and lipid observations, acknowledge possible indirect metabolism and agree that pharmacokinetics and clinical potential require further work.
correspondence_followup.interpretation: This gives a reason for the timing choice; it does not randomize cholesterol, remove illness-course confounding, demonstrate mediation or add a new intervention outcome.

competitiveness.credit: Separate isotope evidence supports entry of administered ketone carbon into mevalonate. Controlled sterol readouts and the earlier force advantage justify a preparation-specific compensation hypothesis.
competitiveness.causal_limit: No independent force replication, final-cholesterol labeling, membrane-specific measurement or necessity/mediation experiment. The human evidence is observational, with table-scale and covariate ambiguities.
competitiveness.decision: Retain the injected D,L sodium salt as an exploratory compensation comparison. This mechanism does not establish BUBR1 restoration, clinical or MVA efficacy, oral/retail equivalence, or superiority over provisional niacin/apitegromab.
competitiveness.next_evidence: Test justified measured exposure and sodium-matched controls with absolute useful output, renewal, fidelity and survival/starting-unit denominators. A sterol-specific perturbation plus appropriate rescue, final-product tracing and membrane measurements would distinguish the proposed mediator from parallel biochemical changes.
